user.title: Choose your heat pump
user.description: Home Assistant found these Remeha Bluetooth modules.

pin.title: Enter the PIN
pin.description:
Found **{name}**.

Type the 6-digit PIN from the sticker on the Bluetooth module of the heat pump. Connecting takes up to a minute.

error.invalid_pin: The module refused this PIN. Check the sticker and wait 1 minute before trying again.
error.cannot_connect: Could not connect. Is Home Assistant close enough to the heat pump? If the Remeha app on a phone is connected, close it. Then try again.
error.auth_failed: Connected, but the module did not answer. Try again.

abort.already_configured: This heat pump is already set up.
abort.no_devices_found: No Remeha Bluetooth module found. Make sure Bluetooth works in Home Assistant and the heat pump is close enough.
